title: The Inhabitants of the Two Gardens
intro: In a land where blessings flowed abundantly, a community once enjoyed the bounty of two magnificent gardens. Their lives were a testament to divine favor, yet their story took a turn when gratitude waned, leading to a transformation that would become a lasting sign for all who reflect.
clues: We were a people blessed with a land of ease and abundance.
Our Lord granted us two splendid gardens, lush and fruitful on every side.
We were commanded to be grateful, but we chose ingratitude and turned away.
A great dam held back the waters that gave life to our land.
When we persisted in our wrongdoing, the dam burst and the floodwaters swept through.
Our once-lush gardens were replaced by bitter fruit, tamarisks, and a few lote trees.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: A violent wind for seven nights
A shower of stones from the sky
A destructive flood from a bursting dam
A loud shriek from the sky
trial.answer: A destructive flood from a bursting dam

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Our gardens were replaced with bitter fruit and sparse trees
We were swallowed by the earth in an earthquake
We were transformed into apes and pigs
We were drowned in a great flood
We were destroyed by a shower of stones
outcome.answer: Our gardens were replaced with bitter fruit and sparse trees

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
